local_frankenstein_harness.description: The locally running Frankenstein harness/worker fabric is the preferred execution path for interactive coding, host work, terminal operation and ephemeral task workers.

free_swarm.description: Free Swarm is permitted again, but is not the default execution fabric. Use it when the primary local harness lacks capability/capacity, when explicitly selected, or as a bounded fallback.

execution_invariants: Resolve current host/project capability authority at execution time; this owner policy does not bypass effect/write/network gates.
Local host effects preserve machine_id and owner provenance on every command and receipt.
Material effects require durable receipts/read-back evidence at the claimed scope.
Local fan-out requires current host telemetry and resource admission; unknown/red telemetry fails closed.
Free Swarm/provider execution may not bypass the same capability, write, effect, provenance, receipt or host-safety boundaries.
Do not create a second cognitive database or a parallel terminal-only/chat-only state store.
supersedes_policy_claim: Free Swarm/provider admission is categorically HARD_OFF as an owner policy.
does_not_claim: that every concrete runtime/provider switch has already been toggled on every host
that a provider is healthy merely because Free Swarm is permitted
that existing safety gates may be weakened
